title: kith-events: support ping query parameter per RFC 8620 §7.3
description: eventSourceUrl in JMAP Session will include {ping} template variable per RFC 8620 §7.3. Server must accept ping=N (seconds) and send SSE comment heartbeats at that interval. Currently EventsQuery has no ping field; ping values are silently dropped and keepalive is hardcoded at 15s. Deferred from Phase 1 (Session object not yet implemented). Must be addressed when kithd/src/session.rs is written.
